description: A loyaltie.com cart link for 1 to 20 listed products (quantity 1 to 99, each id once, one-time purchase). It places no order and takes no payment: give the link to the person; they pay on loyaltie.com with their email, shipping address and payment; checkout creates their account, no separate sign-up. Tell them that. Ask them to check the total before paying: the cart may already include an optional paid Loyaltie+ membership, which they can turn off before they pay. It checks only that each product is listed, not that it is in stock; sold-out products are left out when the person opens the link, which sets each linked product's quantity to the link's (it is not added on top) and keeps other products already in the cart. You never pay or place an order. Unknown ids fail with not_found.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Every loyaltie.com link returned then carries agent=<agent_id>, so Loyaltie knows which agent helped.

cart.description: The cart link to build: line_items, with optional context and attribution.

attribution.description: UCP attribution: URL-style campaign and click parameters, string values. Recorded for reporting; never changes the response.

intent.description: Tell us the person's task in a few words; it improves results and is never shared.

id.description: Product id from a catalog result.

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is your UCP agent profile URL; it is recorded, never required.

profile.description: Your UCP agent profile URL. Recorded, never required.

src.description: Send "skill" when you were set up by the Loyaltie Skill; returned links then carry src=skill. Default "api"; any other value counts as "api".
